sections.title: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)
sections.body:
### Soft Assignments: Responsibilities

### **Posterior Probability (Responsibility)**

Probability that point $x_i$ belongs to component $k$:

$$
\gamma_{ik} = P(z_i = k | x_i) = \frac{\pi_k \mathcal{N}(x_i | \mu_k, \Sigma_k)}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} \pi_j \mathcal{N}(x_i | \mu_j, \Sigma_j)}
$$

**In words:** "How responsible is component $k$ for generating point $x_i$?"

### **Hard vs Soft Assignments**

```python
# Predict probabilities (soft assignments)
probs = gmm.predict_proba(X)

# Hard assignments (argmax of probabilities)
labels = gmm.predict(X)

# Show first 10 points
print("Soft Assignments (Probabilities):")
print("Point | Cluster 0 | Cluster 1 | Cluster 2 | Hard Assignment")
print("-" * 60)
for i in range(10):
    print(f"{i:5d} | {probs[i, 0]:9.3f} | {probs[i, 1]:9.3f} | {probs[i, 2]:9.3f} | {labels[i]:15d}")

# Visualize soft vs hard
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6))

# Hard assignments (K-Means style)
axes[0].scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, s=100, cmap='viridis',
               edgecolors='black', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
axes[0].scatter(means[:, 0], means[:, 1], c='red', s=300, marker='X',
               edgecolors='black', linewidth=2)
axes[0].set_title('Hard Assignments (Argmax)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=14)
axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Soft assignments (color by confidence)
# Color by most probable cluster, alpha by confidence
for k in range(3):
    mask = (labels == k)
    confidences = probs[mask, k]
    axes[1].scatter(X[mask, 0], X[mask, 1], s=100, c=[plt.cm.viridis(k/3)],
                   alpha=confidences, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)

axes[1].scatter(means[:, 0], means[:, 1], c='red', s=300, marker='X',
               edgecolors='black', linewidth=2)
axes[1].set_title('Soft Assignments (Opacity = Confidence)', 
                 fontweight='bold', fontsize=14)
axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("\nKey Insight:")
print("  - High confidence (solid): Far from decision boundary")
print("  - Low confidence (faded): Near decision boundary (overlapping region)")
```
